def three_levels(items: list[int]) -> int:
    total = 0
    for item in items:
        if item > 0:
            while total < item:
                total += 1
    return total


def elif_chain_is_two_levels(value: int) -> str:
    if value > 0:
        if value > 10:
            return "large"
        return "small"
    elif value < 0:
        if value < -10:
            return "very negative"
        return "negative"
    else:
        return "zero"
